explanation.fr: 'Farther' s'utilise pour la distance physique (farther away). 'Further' s'utilise au sens figuré (further discussion) et peut aussi signifier 'davantage'.
explanation.en: 'Farther' is used for physical distance (farther away). 'Further' is used figuratively (further discussion) and can also mean 'additional'.
explanation.es: 'Farther' se usa para distancia física (farther away). 'Further' se usa en sentido figurado (further discussion) y puede significar 'adicional'.
explanation.de: 'Farther' wird für physische Entfernung verwendet (farther away). 'Further' wird im übertragenen Sinne verwendet (further discussion) und kann auch 'zusätzlich' bedeuten.

explanation.fr: 'Ephemeral' signifie 'éphémère', quelque chose qui ne dure qu'un très court instant. Ex: 'The beauty of cherry blossoms is ephemeral.'
explanation.en: 'Ephemeral' means lasting for a very short time. Example: 'The beauty of cherry blossoms is ephemeral.'
explanation.es: 'Ephemeral' significa 'efímero', algo que dura muy poco tiempo. Ej: 'The beauty of cherry blossoms is ephemeral.'
explanation.de: 'Ephemeral' bedeutet 'kurzlebig' oder 'flüchtig'. Bsp: 'The beauty of cherry blossoms is ephemeral.'

choiceLeft.fr: Fait de manière machinale / Sans enthousiasme
choiceLeft.en: Done without care / As a mere formality
choiceLeft.es: Hecho de forma mecánica / Sin entusiasmo

explanation.fr: 'Perfunctory' signifie 'fait machinalement', sans réel intérêt ni effort. Ex: 'He gave a perfunctory nod.'
explanation.en: 'Perfunctory' means carried out with minimal effort or thought, merely as a formality. Example: 'He gave a perfunctory nod.'
explanation.es: 'Perfunctory' significa 'hecho mecánicamente', sin interés real ni esfuerzo. Ej: 'He gave a perfunctory nod.'
explanation.de: 'Perfunctory' bedeutet 'oberflächlich erledigt', ohne echtes Interesse. Bsp: 'He gave a perfunctory nod.'

choiceRight.es: Por excelencia / El ejemplo perfecto de
choiceRight.de: Das perfekte Beispiel für / Inbegriff von

explanation.fr: 'Quintessential' signifie 'par excellence', le meilleur exemple possible. Ex: 'Paris is the quintessential romantic city.'
explanation.en: 'Quintessential' means representing the most perfect or typical example. Example: 'Paris is the quintessential romantic city.'
explanation.es: 'Quintessential' significa 'por excelencia', el mejor ejemplo posible. Ej: 'Paris is the quintessential romantic city.'
explanation.de: 'Quintessential' bedeutet 'Inbegriff von', das perfekteste Beispiel. Bsp: 'Paris is the quintessential romantic city.'

explanation.fr: 'Albeit' signifie 'bien que' ou 'quoique'. C'est un mot littéraire. Ex: 'The plan was ambitious, albeit risky.'
explanation.en: 'Albeit' is a formal conjunction meaning 'although' or 'even though'. Example: 'The plan was ambitious, albeit risky.'
explanation.es: 'Albeit' significa 'aunque' o 'si bien'. Es una palabra literaria. Ej: 'The plan was ambitious, albeit risky.'
explanation.de: 'Albeit' bedeutet 'obwohl' oder 'wenn auch'. Es ist ein literarisches Wort. Bsp: 'The plan was ambitious, albeit risky.'

explanation.fr: 'To exacerbate' signifie 'aggraver' ou 'exacerber'. Ex: 'The drought exacerbated the food crisis.'
explanation.en: 'To exacerbate' means to make a problem, situation, or feeling worse. Example: 'The drought exacerbated the food crisis.'
explanation.es: 'To exacerbate' significa 'agravar' o 'exacerbar'. Ej: 'The drought exacerbated the food crisis.'
explanation.de: 'To exacerbate' bedeutet 'verschlimmern' oder 'verschärfen'. Bsp: 'The drought exacerbated the food crisis.'

choiceLeft.en: Too great to be expressed in words

explanation.fr: 'Ineffable' signifie 'indicible', trop grand ou trop beau pour être exprimé par des mots. Ex: 'The ineffable beauty of the sunset.'
explanation.en: 'Ineffable' means too great, extreme, or beautiful to be adequately described in words. Example: 'The ineffable beauty of the sunset.'
explanation.es: 'Ineffable' significa 'inefable', demasiado grande o hermoso para ser expresado con palabras. Ej: 'The ineffable beauty of the sunset.'
explanation.de: 'Ineffable' bedeutet 'unbeschreiblich', zu groß oder zu schön, um in Worte gefasst zu werden. Bsp: 'The ineffable beauty of the sunset.'

question.fr: Quelle est la forme correcte ? 'I ___ to play football when I was young.'
question.en: Which is correct? 'I ___ to play football when I was young.'
question.es: ¿Cuál es la forma correcta? 'I ___ to play football when I was young.'
question.de: Welche Form ist richtig? 'I ___ to play football when I was young.'

explanation.fr: 'Used to' exprime une habitude passée qui n'existe plus. 'I used to play' = 'Je jouais (avant)'.
explanation.en: 'Used to' describes a past habit that no longer exists. 'I used to play' = I played regularly in the past.
explanation.es: 'Used to' expresa un hábito pasado que ya no existe. 'I used to play' = 'Yo solía jugar'.
explanation.de: 'Used to' beschreibt eine vergangene Gewohnheit. 'I used to play' = 'Ich habe früher gespielt'.

explanation.fr: 'To wonder' signifie 'se demander'. Attention au faux ami : 'to wander' (avec un a) signifie 'errer'.
explanation.en: 'To wonder' means to think about something curiously. Don't confuse it with 'to wander' (to walk without direction).
explanation.es: 'To wonder' significa 'preguntarse'. No confundir con 'to wander' (vagar, deambular).
explanation.de: 'To wonder' bedeutet 'sich fragen'. Nicht verwechseln mit 'to wander' (umherwandern).

question.fr: Quelle est la forme passive correcte ? 'The book ___ by millions.'
question.en: Which passive form is correct? 'The book ___ by millions.'
question.es: ¿Cuál es la forma pasiva correcta? 'The book ___ by millions.'
question.de: Welche Passivform ist richtig? 'The book ___ by millions.'

explanation.fr: 'Read' est un verbe irrégulier : read/read/read. Le past participle est 'read' (prononcé /rɛd/), pas 'readed'.
explanation.en: 'Read' is an irregular verb: read/read/read. The past participle is 'read' (pronounced /rɛd/), not 'readed'.
explanation.es: 'Read' es un verbo irregular: read/read/read. El participio pasado es 'read' (pronunciado /rɛd/), no 'readed'.
explanation.de: 'Read' ist ein unregelmäßiges Verb: read/read/read. Das Partizip ist 'read' (ausgesprochen /rɛd/), nicht 'readed'.

explanation.fr: 'Nevertheless' signifie 'néanmoins, toutefois'. Il introduit une idée contraire à ce qui précède. Ne pas confondre avec 'never'.
explanation.en: 'Nevertheless' means 'in spite of that'. It introduces a contrasting idea. Don't be misled by the 'never' at the start.
explanation.es: 'Nevertheless' significa 'sin embargo'. Introduce una idea contraria. No confundir con 'never' (nunca).
explanation.de: 'Nevertheless' bedeutet 'trotzdem, dennoch'. Es leitet einen Gegensatz ein. Nicht mit 'never' (niemals) verwechseln.

question.fr: Quelle est la forme correcte ? 'I look forward ___ you.'
question.en: Which is correct? 'I look forward ___ you.'
question.es: ¿Cuál es la forma correcta? 'I look forward ___ you.'
question.de: Welche Form ist richtig? 'I look forward ___ you.'

explanation.fr: 'To look forward to' est suivi d'un gérondif (-ing). 'To' est ici une préposition, pas l'infinitif. → 'I look forward to seeing you.'
explanation.en: 'To look forward to' is followed by a gerund (-ing). Here 'to' is a preposition, not part of the infinitive. → 'I look forward to seeing you.'
explanation.es: 'To look forward to' va seguido de gerundio (-ing). Aquí 'to' es preposición, no infinitivo. → 'I look forward to seeing you.'
explanation.de: 'To look forward to' wird mit Gerundium (-ing) verwendet. 'To' ist hier eine Präposition, kein Infinitiv. → 'I look forward to seeing you.'

explanation.fr: 'Dog' signifie 'chien'. C'est l'animal de compagnie le plus populaire au monde.
explanation.en: 'Dog' is a domesticated canine, known as man's best friend.
explanation.es: 'Dog' significa 'perro'. Es la mascota más popular del mundo.
explanation.de: 'Dog' bedeutet 'Hund'. Es ist das beliebteste Haustier der Welt.

explanation.fr: 'Fish' signifie 'poisson'. Ce mot est identique au singulier et au pluriel : one fish, two fish.
explanation.en: 'Fish' is unique because its plural is the same: one fish, two fish.
explanation.es: 'Fish' significa 'pez'. En inglés, el plural es igual: one fish, two fish.
explanation.de: 'Fish' bedeutet 'Fisch'. Der Plural ist gleich: one fish, two fish.

explanation.fr: 'Bird' signifie 'oiseau'. En argot britannique, 'bird' peut aussi désigner une fille.
explanation.en: 'Bird' means a feathered animal. In British slang, it can also mean a girl.
explanation.es: 'Bird' significa 'pájaro'. En el argot británico, también puede significar chica.
explanation.de: 'Bird' bedeutet 'Vogel'. Im britischen Slang kann es auch Mädchen bedeuten.

explanation.fr: 'Horse' signifie 'cheval'. L'expression 'horsepower' (chevaux-vapeur) vient de ce mot.
explanation.en: 'Horse' is a large hoofed animal. The unit 'horsepower' comes from this word.
explanation.es: 'Horse' significa 'caballo'. La unidad 'horsepower' (caballos de fuerza) viene de esta palabra.
explanation.de: 'Horse' bedeutet 'Pferd'. Die Einheit 'horsepower' (Pferdestärke) kommt von diesem Wort.

explanation.fr: 'Rabbit' signifie 'lapin'. Ne pas confondre avec 'hare' qui désigne un lièvre.
explanation.en: 'Rabbit' is a small furry animal. A 'hare' is similar but larger and faster.
explanation.es: 'Rabbit' significa 'conejo'. No confundir con 'hare', que es una liebre.
explanation.de: 'Rabbit' bedeutet 'Kaninchen'. Nicht verwechseln mit 'hare' (Hase).

explanation.fr: 'Cow' signifie 'vache'. Le mâle se dit 'bull' (taureau) en anglais.
explanation.en: 'Cow' is the female. The male is called a 'bull'.
explanation.es: 'Cow' significa 'vaca'. El macho se llama 'bull' (toro) en inglés.
explanation.de: 'Cow' bedeutet 'Kuh'. Das männliche Tier heißt 'bull' (Stier).

explanation.fr: 'Sheep' signifie 'mouton'. Comme 'fish', le pluriel est identique : one sheep, two sheep.
explanation.en: 'Sheep' has the same singular and plural form: one sheep, two sheep.
explanation.es: 'Sheep' significa 'oveja'. Como 'fish', el plural es igual: one sheep, two sheep.
explanation.de: 'Sheep' bedeutet 'Schaf'. Wie 'fish' ist der Plural gleich: one sheep, two sheep.

explanation.fr: 'Elephant' signifie 'éléphant'. C'est le plus grand animal terrestre vivant.
explanation.en: 'Elephant' is the largest living land animal, found in Africa and Asia.
explanation.es: 'Elephant' significa 'elefante'. Es el animal terrestre más grande del mundo.
explanation.de: 'Elephant' bedeutet 'Elefant'. Es ist das größte lebende Landtier.

explanation.fr: 'Red' signifie 'rouge'. Attention : en espagnol, 'red' signifie 'réseau', c'est un faux ami !
explanation.en: 'Red' is the color of fire and blood. Fun fact: in Spanish, 'red' means 'network'.
explanation.es: 'Red' significa 'rojo' en inglés. ¡Cuidado! En español, 'red' significa otra cosa.
explanation.de: 'Red' bedeutet 'Rot'. Achtung: Im Spanischen bedeutet 'red' 'Netzwerk'!

explanation.fr: 'Green' signifie 'vert'. 'To be green' peut aussi signifier être écologique ou inexpérimenté.
explanation.en: 'Green' is the color of grass. 'To be green' can also mean to be inexperienced.
explanation.es: 'Green' significa 'verde'. 'To be green' también puede significar ser inexperto.
explanation.de: 'Green' bedeutet 'Grün'. 'To be green' kann auch unerfahren bedeuten.

explanation.fr: 'Yellow' signifie 'jaune'. C'est la couleur du soleil et des taxis new-yorkais.
explanation.en: 'Yellow' is the color of the sun and New York taxis.
explanation.es: 'Yellow' significa 'amarillo'. Es el color del sol y de los taxis de Nueva York.
explanation.de: 'Yellow' bedeutet 'Gelb'. Es ist die Farbe der Sonne und der New Yorker Taxis.

explanation.fr: 'Black' signifie 'noir'. Son contraire est 'white' (blanc).
explanation.en: 'Black' is the opposite of 'white'. 'Blackout' means a power failure.
explanation.es: 'Black' significa 'negro'. Su opuesto es 'white' (blanco).
explanation.de: 'Black' bedeutet 'Schwarz'. Das Gegenteil ist 'white' (Weiß).

explanation.fr: 'White' signifie 'blanc'. La Maison Blanche se dit 'The White House' en anglais.
explanation.en: 'White' is the color of snow. The White House is the US president's residence.
explanation.es: 'White' significa 'blanco'. La Casa Blanca se dice 'The White House'.
explanation.de: 'White' bedeutet 'Weiß'. Das Weiße Haus heißt 'The White House'.

explanation.fr: 'Pink' signifie 'rose'. L'expression 'in the pink' signifie être en pleine forme.
explanation.en: 'Pink' is a light red color. 'In the pink' means being in good health.
explanation.es: 'Pink' significa 'rosa'. La expresión 'in the pink' significa estar en buena forma.
explanation.de: 'Pink' bedeutet 'Rosa'. 'In the pink' bedeutet, bei bester Gesundheit zu sein.

explanation.fr: 'Orange' est à la fois une couleur et un fruit en anglais, comme en français.
explanation.en: 'Orange' is both a color and a fruit. The color was named after the fruit!
explanation.es: 'Orange' es tanto un color como una fruta en inglés. ¡El color se nombró por la fruta!
explanation.de: 'Orange' ist sowohl eine Farbe als auch eine Frucht. Die Farbe wurde nach der Frucht benannt!

explanation.fr: 'One' signifie 'un' (le chiffre 1). Se prononce comme 'wonne', pas comme 'ône'.
explanation.en: 'One' is the number 1. It's pronounced 'wun', not 'own'.
explanation.es: 'One' significa 'uno'. Se pronuncia 'wan', no 'oun'.
explanation.de: 'One' bedeutet 'Eins'. Es wird 'wan' ausgesprochen, nicht 'oun'.

explanation.fr: 'Two' signifie 'deux'. Attention : 'two', 'too' et 'to' se prononcent pareil !
explanation.en: 'Two' is the number 2. 'Two', 'too', and 'to' all sound the same!
explanation.es: 'Two' significa 'dos'. ¡'Two', 'too' y 'to' se pronuncian igual!
explanation.de: 'Two' bedeutet 'Zwei'. 'Two', 'too' und 'to' klingen gleich!

explanation.fr: 'Four' signifie 'quatre'. Ne pas confondre avec 'for' (pour) qui se prononce pareil.
explanation.en: 'Four' is the number 4. Don't confuse it with 'for', which sounds the same.
explanation.es: 'Four' significa 'cuatro'. No confundir con 'for' (para), que suena igual.
explanation.de: 'Four' bedeutet 'Vier'. Nicht verwechseln mit 'for' (für), das gleich klingt.

explanation.fr: 'Five' signifie 'cinq'. 'High five' est un geste où on tape dans la main de quelqu'un.
explanation.en: 'Five' is the number 5. A 'high five' is a celebratory hand slap.
explanation.es: 'Five' significa 'cinco'. 'High five' es chocar las palmas en celebración.
explanation.de: 'Five' bedeutet 'Fünf'. Ein 'High five' ist ein feierlicher Handschlag.

explanation.fr: 'Six' signifie 'six'. Ce mot s'écrit presque pareil en français et en anglais !
explanation.en: 'Six' is the number 6. It's almost the same word in French and English!
explanation.es: 'Six' significa 'seis'. ¡Se escribe casi igual en francés e inglés!
explanation.de: 'Six' bedeutet 'Sechs'. Es wird fast gleich auf Französisch und Englisch geschrieben!

explanation.fr: 'Seven' signifie 'sept'. Le chiffre 7 est considéré comme porte-bonheur dans la culture anglophone.
explanation.en: 'Seven' is the number 7, often considered a lucky number in Western culture.
explanation.es: 'Seven' significa 'siete'. El 7 se considera un número de la suerte en la cultura anglosajona.
explanation.de: 'Seven' bedeutet 'Sieben'. Die 7 gilt in der westlichen Kultur als Glückszahl.

explanation.fr: 'Ten' signifie 'dix'. Attention en espagnol : 'ten' est l'impératif de 'tener' (avoir) !
explanation.en: 'Ten' is the number 10. In Spanish, 'ten' means 'have' (imperative) — a false friend!
explanation.es: 'Ten' significa 'diez' en inglés. ¡Cuidado! No es el imperativo de 'tener'.
explanation.de: 'Ten' bedeutet 'Zehn'. Im Spanischen bedeutet 'ten' 'hab' — ein falscher Freund!

explanation.fr: 'Head' signifie 'tête'. Ne pas confondre avec 'heart' (cœur) qui commence pareil.
explanation.en: 'Head' is the top part of the body. Don't confuse it with 'heart'!
explanation.es: 'Head' significa 'cabeza'. No confundir con 'heart' (corazón).
explanation.de: 'Head' bedeutet 'Kopf'. Nicht verwechseln mit 'heart' (Herz)!

explanation.fr: 'Hand' signifie 'main'. Ce mot est identique en anglais et en allemand !
explanation.en: 'Hand' is at the end of your arm. It's the same word in English and German!
explanation.es: 'Hand' significa 'mano'. ¡Se escribe igual en inglés y en alemán!
explanation.de: 'Hand' bedeutet 'Hand'. Dieses Wort ist auf Englisch und Deutsch identisch!

explanation.fr: 'Eye' signifie 'œil'. Se prononce comme la lettre 'I' (aï).
explanation.en: 'Eye' is the organ of sight. It's pronounced exactly like the letter 'I'.
explanation.es: 'Eye' significa 'ojo'. Se pronuncia igual que la letra 'I' (ai).
explanation.de: 'Eye' bedeutet 'Auge'. Es wird wie der Buchstabe 'I' (ai) ausgesprochen.

explanation.fr: 'Mouth' signifie 'bouche'. Le 'th' se prononce en plaçant la langue entre les dents.
explanation.en: 'Mouth' is used for eating and speaking. The 'th' sound requires the tongue between the teeth.
explanation.es: 'Mouth' significa 'boca'. El sonido 'th' se pronuncia con la lengua entre los dientes.
explanation.de: 'Mouth' bedeutet 'Mund'. Der 'th'-Laut wird mit der Zunge zwischen den Zähnen gebildet.

explanation.fr: 'Ear' signifie 'oreille'. Ne pas confondre avec 'year' (année) qui se prononce presque pareil.
explanation.en: 'Ear' is the hearing organ. Don't confuse it with 'year', which sounds similar.
explanation.es: 'Ear' significa 'oreja'. No confundir con 'year' (año), que suena parecido.
explanation.de: 'Ear' bedeutet 'Ohr'. Nicht verwechseln mit 'year' (Jahr), das ähnlich klingt.

explanation.fr: 'Nose' signifie 'nez'. Ressemble au mot allemand 'Nase' et au français 'nez'.
explanation.en: 'Nose' is the organ of smell. It's similar to German 'Nase' and French 'nez'.
explanation.es: 'Nose' significa 'nariz'. Se parece al alemán 'Nase' y al francés 'nez'.
explanation.de: 'Nose' bedeutet 'Nase'. Es ist dem deutschen Wort sehr ähnlich!

explanation.fr: 'Leg' signifie 'jambe'. Ce mot court de 3 lettres est facile à retenir !
explanation.en: 'Leg' is the lower limb used for walking. Short and easy to remember!
explanation.es: 'Leg' significa 'pierna'. ¡Una palabra corta y fácil de recordar!
explanation.de: 'Leg' bedeutet 'Bein'. Ein kurzes, leicht zu merkendes Wort!

explanation.fr: 'Foot' signifie 'pied'. Le pluriel irrégulier est 'feet'. 'Football' = le sport du pied et du ballon.
explanation.en: 'Foot' is at the end of your leg. Its plural is irregular: feet, not foots.
explanation.es: 'Foot' significa 'pie'. El plural irregular es 'feet'. 'Football' = deporte del pie.
explanation.de: 'Foot' bedeutet 'Fuß'. Der Plural ist unregelmäßig: feet, nicht foots.

explanation.fr: 'Mother' signifie 'mère'. On dit aussi 'Mum' (britannique) ou 'Mom' (américain).
explanation.en: 'Mother' means mum/mom. British say 'Mum', Americans say 'Mom'.
explanation.es: 'Mother' significa 'madre'. Los británicos dicen 'Mum', los americanos 'Mom'.
explanation.de: 'Mother' bedeutet 'Mutter'. Briten sagen 'Mum', Amerikaner sagen 'Mom'.

explanation.fr: 'Father' signifie 'père'. On dit aussi 'Dad' ou 'Daddy' de manière informelle.
explanation.en: 'Father' is a formal word for dad. Informally: 'Dad' or 'Daddy'.
explanation.es: 'Father' significa 'padre'. Informalmente se dice 'Dad' o 'Daddy'.
explanation.de: 'Father' bedeutet 'Vater'. Informell sagt man 'Dad' oder 'Daddy'.

explanation.fr: 'Sister' signifie 'sœur'. Ressemble au mot allemand 'Schwester'.
explanation.en: 'Sister' means a female sibling. It's related to German 'Schwester'.
explanation.es: 'Sister' significa 'hermana'. Se parece al alemán 'Schwester'.
explanation.de: 'Sister' bedeutet 'Schwester'. Die Wörter sind verwandt!

explanation.fr: 'Brother' signifie 'frère'. Ressemble au mot allemand 'Bruder'.
explanation.en: 'Brother' means a male sibling. It's related to German 'Bruder'.
explanation.es: 'Brother' significa 'hermano'. Se parece al alemán 'Bruder'.
explanation.de: 'Brother' bedeutet 'Bruder'. Die Wörter sind eng verwandt!

explanation.fr: 'Baby' signifie 'bébé'. Ce mot existe aussi en allemand avec la même orthographe.
explanation.en: 'Baby' is a very young child. This word exists in many languages!
explanation.es: 'Baby' significa 'bebé'. ¡Esta palabra existe en muchos idiomas!
explanation.de: 'Baby' bedeutet 'Baby'. Dieses Wort existiert auch im Deutschen!

explanation.fr: 'Family' signifie 'famille'. Ce mot est très similaire en français, espagnol et allemand.
explanation.en: 'Family' means a group of related people. Similar in many European languages.
explanation.es: 'Family' significa 'familia'. Es similar en francés, español y alemán.
explanation.de: 'Family' bedeutet 'Familie'. Ähnlich in vielen europäischen Sprachen.

explanation.fr: 'Girl' signifie 'fille' (jeune). Pour une femme adulte, on dit 'woman'.
explanation.en: 'Girl' means a young female. An adult female is called a 'woman'.
explanation.es: 'Girl' significa 'chica'. Una mujer adulta se dice 'woman'.
explanation.de: 'Girl' bedeutet 'Mädchen'. Eine erwachsene Frau heißt 'woman'.

explanation.fr: 'Boy' signifie 'garçon' (jeune). Pour un homme adulte, on dit 'man'.
explanation.en: 'Boy' means a young male. An adult male is called a 'man'.
explanation.es: 'Boy' significa 'chico'. Un hombre adulto se dice 'man'.
explanation.de: 'Boy' bedeutet 'Junge'. Ein erwachsener Mann heißt 'man'.

explanation.fr: 'Milk' signifie 'lait'. Très proche de l'allemand 'Milch'.
explanation.en: 'Milk' is a white drink from cows. Very close to German 'Milch'.
explanation.es: 'Milk' significa 'leche'. Muy parecido al alemán 'Milch'.
explanation.de: 'Milk' bedeutet 'Milch'. Die Wörter sind fast identisch!

explanation.fr: 'Egg' signifie 'œuf'. 'Scrambled eggs' = œufs brouillés, un classique du petit-déjeuner anglais.
explanation.en: 'Egg' comes from hens. 'Scrambled eggs' is a classic English breakfast item.
explanation.es: 'Egg' significa 'huevo'. 'Scrambled eggs' = huevos revueltos, un clásico del desayuno inglés.
explanation.de: 'Egg' bedeutet 'Ei'. 'Scrambled eggs' = Rührei, ein Klassiker des englischen Frühstücks.

explanation.fr: 'Rice' signifie 'riz'. C'est l'aliment de base de plus de la moitié de la population mondiale.
explanation.en: 'Rice' is a staple food for over half the world's population.
explanation.es: 'Rice' significa 'arroz'. Es el alimento básico de más de la mitad de la población mundial.
explanation.de: 'Rice' bedeutet 'Reis'. Es ist das Grundnahrungsmittel für über die Hälfte der Weltbevölkerung.

explanation.fr: 'Chicken' signifie 'poulet' (la viande) ou 'poule' (l'animal). En argot, ça veut aussi dire 'peureux'.
explanation.en: 'Chicken' is both the animal and the meat. Informally, it can mean 'coward'.
explanation.es: 'Chicken' significa 'pollo'. Informalmente, también puede significar 'cobarde'.
explanation.de: 'Chicken' bedeutet 'Hähnchen'. Umgangssprachlich kann es auch 'Feigling' bedeuten.

explanation.fr: 'Cheese' signifie 'fromage'. On dit 'cheese!' quand on prend une photo (pour sourire).
explanation.en: Say 'Cheese!' when taking a photo — it makes you smile!
explanation.es: 'Cheese' significa 'queso'. Se dice '¡Cheese!' al tomar una foto para sonreír.
explanation.de: 'Cheese' bedeutet 'Käse'. Man sagt 'Cheese!' beim Fotografieren, um zu lächeln.

explanation.fr: 'Fruit' signifie 'fruit'. Ce mot s'écrit exactement pareil en anglais et en français !
explanation.en: 'Fruit' is food from plants. It's spelled the same in English and French!
explanation.es: 'Fruit' significa 'fruta'. ¡Se escribe igual en inglés y francés!
explanation.de: 'Fruit' bedeutet 'Frucht'. Es wird auf Englisch und Französisch gleich geschrieben!

explanation.fr: 'Car' signifie 'voiture'. Attention : en français, un 'car' est un autobus !
explanation.en: 'Car' is a road vehicle. In French, 'car' means a bus — a false friend!
explanation.es: 'Car' significa 'coche'. En francés, 'car' significa autobús — ¡un falso amigo!
explanation.de: 'Car' bedeutet 'Auto'. Im Französischen bedeutet 'car' Bus — ein falscher Freund!

explanation.fr: 'Phone' signifie 'téléphone'. C'est l'abréviation de 'telephone'.
explanation.en: 'Phone' is short for 'telephone'. It comes from Greek 'phōnē' (voice).
explanation.es: 'Phone' significa 'teléfono'. Es la abreviatura de 'telephone'.
explanation.de: 'Phone' bedeutet 'Telefon'. Es ist die Kurzform von 'telephone'.

explanation.fr: 'Chair' signifie 'chaise'. Attention au faux ami : en français, 'chair' signifie 'flesh' (viande/peau) !
explanation.en: 'Chair' is for sitting. In French, 'chair' means 'flesh' — a false friend!
explanation.es: 'Chair' significa 'silla'. En francés, 'chair' significa 'carne' — ¡un falso amigo!
explanation.de: 'Chair' bedeutet 'Stuhl'. Im Französischen bedeutet 'chair' 'Fleisch' — ein falscher Freund!

explanation.fr: 'Table' s'écrit pareil en anglais et en français ! La prononciation est différente : 'téïbeul'.
explanation.en: 'Table' is spelled the same in English and French but pronounced differently.
explanation.es: 'Table' significa 'mesa'. Se escribe igual en inglés y francés, pero se pronuncia diferente.
explanation.de: 'Table' bedeutet 'Tisch'. Es wird auf Englisch und Französisch gleich geschrieben.

explanation.fr: 'Door' signifie 'porte'. L'expression 'next door' signifie 'à côté' (le voisin).
explanation.en: 'Door' is an entrance. 'Next door' means the house or building beside yours.
explanation.es: 'Door' significa 'puerta'. 'Next door' significa 'al lado' (el vecino).
explanation.de: 'Door' bedeutet 'Tür'. 'Next door' bedeutet 'nebenan' (der Nachbar).

explanation.fr: 'Star' signifie 'étoile'. Ce mot désigne aussi une célébrité : 'a movie star'.
explanation.en: 'Star' means a celestial body or a celebrity: 'a movie star'.
explanation.es: 'Star' significa 'estrella'. También se usa para celebridades: 'a movie star'.
explanation.de: 'Star' bedeutet 'Stern'. Es bezeichnet auch einen Promi: 'a movie star'.

explanation.fr: 'Shirt' signifie 'chemise'. Un 'T-shirt' est une chemise en forme de T.
explanation.en: 'Shirt' is a top garment. A 'T-shirt' gets its name from its T shape.
explanation.es: 'Shirt' significa 'camisa'. Una 'T-shirt' se llama así por su forma de T.
explanation.de: 'Shirt' bedeutet 'Hemd'. Ein 'T-Shirt' heißt so wegen seiner T-Form.

explanation.fr: 'Shoes' signifie 'chaussures'. Proche de l'allemand 'Schuhe'.
explanation.en: 'Shoes' are worn on feet. Similar to German 'Schuhe'.
explanation.es: 'Shoes' significa 'zapatos'. Similar al alemán 'Schuhe'.
explanation.de: 'Shoes' bedeutet 'Schuhe'. Die Wörter sind verwandt!

explanation.fr: 'Hat' signifie 'chapeau'. Proche de l'allemand 'Hut'. Ne pas confondre avec 'cap' (casquette).
explanation.en: 'Hat' is worn on the head. A 'cap' is a type of hat with a visor.
explanation.es: 'Hat' significa 'sombrero'. No confundir con 'cap' (gorra).
explanation.de: 'Hat' bedeutet 'Hut'. Die Wörter sind sehr ähnlich!

explanation.fr: 'Dress' signifie 'robe'. 'To dress' signifie aussi 's'habiller'.
explanation.en: 'Dress' is a one-piece garment. 'To dress' also means 'to put on clothes'.
explanation.es: 'Dress' significa 'vestido'. 'To dress' también significa 'vestirse'.
explanation.de: 'Dress' bedeutet 'Kleid'. 'To dress' bedeutet auch 'sich anziehen'.

explanation.fr: 'Pants' signifie 'pantalon' en américain. Attention : en anglais britannique, 'pants' = sous-vêtements !
explanation.en: In American English, 'pants' means trousers. In British English, 'pants' means underwear!
explanation.es: 'Pants' significa 'pantalón' en inglés americano. En británico, ¡significa ropa interior!
explanation.de: 'Pants' bedeutet 'Hose' (amerikanisch). Im Britischen bedeutet es 'Unterwäsche'!

explanation.fr: 'Coat' signifie 'manteau'. On porte un 'coat' quand il fait froid dehors.
explanation.en: 'Coat' is a warm outer garment for cold weather.
explanation.es: 'Coat' significa 'abrigo'. Se usa cuando hace frío afuera.
explanation.de: 'Coat' bedeutet 'Mantel'. Man trägt ihn bei kaltem Wetter.

explanation.fr: 'Socks' signifie 'chaussettes'. Très proche de l'allemand 'Socken'.
explanation.en: 'Socks' are worn inside shoes. Very similar to German 'Socken'.
explanation.es: 'Socks' significa 'calcetines'. Muy parecido al alemán 'Socken'.
explanation.de: 'Socks' bedeutet 'Socken'. Die Wörter sind fast identisch!

explanation.fr: 'Bedroom' signifie 'chambre'. C'est la combinaison de 'bed' (lit) + 'room' (pièce).
explanation.en: 'Bedroom' is 'bed' + 'room'. English often combines words like this.
explanation.es: 'Bedroom' significa 'dormitorio'. Es la combinación de 'bed' (cama) + 'room' (habitación).
explanation.de: 'Bedroom' bedeutet 'Schlafzimmer'. Es ist 'bed' (Bett) + 'room' (Zimmer).

explanation.fr: 'Bathroom' signifie 'salle de bain'. C'est 'bath' (bain) + 'room' (pièce).
explanation.en: 'Bathroom' is 'bath' + 'room'. In American English, it also means toilet/restroom.
explanation.es: 'Bathroom' significa 'baño'. En inglés americano, también significa aseo.
explanation.de: 'Bathroom' bedeutet 'Badezimmer'. Im Amerikanischen auch Toilette.

explanation.fr: 'Window' signifie 'fenêtre'. Ce mot vient du vieux norrois 'vindauga' (œil du vent).
explanation.en: 'Window' comes from Old Norse 'vindauga' meaning 'wind eye'.
explanation.es: 'Window' significa 'ventana'. Viene del nórdico antiguo 'vindauga' (ojo del viento).
explanation.de: 'Window' bedeutet 'Fenster'. Es kommt vom Altnordischen 'vindauga' (Windauge).

explanation.fr: 'Bed' signifie 'lit'. Proche de l'allemand 'Bett'. 'Go to bed' = aller se coucher.
explanation.en: 'Bed' is for sleeping. 'Go to bed' means to go to sleep.
explanation.es: 'Bed' significa 'cama'. 'Go to bed' significa ir a dormir.
explanation.de: 'Bed' bedeutet 'Bett'. Die Wörter sind fast identisch!

explanation.fr: 'Garden' signifie 'jardin'. Très proche du français et de l'allemand 'Garten'.
explanation.en: 'Garden' is an outdoor area with plants. Similar to French 'jardin' and German 'Garten'.
explanation.es: 'Garden' significa 'jardín'. Similar al francés 'jardin' y al alemán 'Garten'.
explanation.de: 'Garden' bedeutet 'Garten'. Die Wörter sind sehr ähnlich!

explanation.fr: 'Key' signifie 'clé'. Ce mot signifie aussi 'touche' (de clavier) ou 'essentiel'.
explanation.en: 'Key' means a door key, a keyboard key, or something essential.
explanation.es: 'Key' significa 'llave'. También significa 'tecla' (de teclado) o 'clave' (esencial).
explanation.de: 'Key' bedeutet 'Schlüssel'. Es bedeutet auch 'Taste' (Tastatur) oder 'wesentlich'.

explanation.fr: 'Light' signifie 'lumière'. Ce mot signifie aussi 'léger' (contraire de lourd).
explanation.en: 'Light' means illumination. It also means 'not heavy' — two meanings!
explanation.es: 'Light' significa 'luz'. También significa 'ligero' (opuesto de pesado).
explanation.de: 'Light' bedeutet 'Licht'. Es bedeutet auch 'leicht' (Gegenteil von schwer).

explanation.fr: 'Teacher' signifie 'professeur'. Formé de 'teach' (enseigner) + '-er' (celui qui fait).
explanation.en: 'Teacher' comes from 'teach' + '-er'. The '-er' suffix means 'one who does'.
explanation.es: 'Teacher' significa 'profesor'. Viene de 'teach' (enseñar) + '-er' (el que hace).
explanation.de: 'Teacher' bedeutet 'Lehrer'. Es kommt von 'teach' (lehren) + '-er'.

explanation.fr: 'Student' signifie 'élève' ou 'étudiant'. Ce mot existe aussi en allemand !
explanation.en: 'Student' is someone who learns. This word exists in many European languages.
explanation.es: 'Student' significa 'estudiante'. ¡Esta palabra existe en muchos idiomas!
explanation.de: 'Student' bedeutet 'Schüler/Student'. Dieses Wort gibt es auch im Deutschen!

explanation.fr: 'School' signifie 'école'. Proche de l'allemand 'Schule' et de l'espagnol 'escuela'.
explanation.en: 'School' is a place for learning. Similar in German ('Schule') and Spanish ('escuela').
explanation.es: 'School' significa 'escuela'. Parecido al alemán 'Schule'.
explanation.de: 'School' bedeutet 'Schule'. Die Wörter sind fast identisch!

explanation.fr: 'Pen' signifie 'stylo'. Ne pas confondre avec 'pencil' (crayon à papier).
explanation.en: 'Pen' uses ink. A 'pencil' uses graphite. Don't mix them up!
explanation.es: 'Pen' significa 'bolígrafo'. No confundir con 'pencil' (lápiz).
explanation.de: 'Pen' bedeutet 'Kugelschreiber'. Nicht verwechseln mit 'pencil' (Bleistift).

explanation.fr: 'Paper' signifie 'papier'. Ce mot est presque identique en français et en allemand.
explanation.en: 'Paper' is used for writing. Nearly the same in French ('papier') and German ('Papier').
explanation.es: 'Paper' significa 'papel'. Casi idéntico en francés y alemán ('Papier').
explanation.de: 'Paper' bedeutet 'Papier'. Fast identisch auf Englisch, Französisch und Deutsch!

explanation.fr: 'Class' signifie 'classe' ou 'cours'. Ce mot est très similaire dans toutes les langues européennes.
explanation.en: 'Class' means a lesson or a group of students. Similar across European languages.
explanation.es: 'Class' significa 'clase'. ¡Es muy similar en todos los idiomas europeos!
explanation.de: 'Class' bedeutet 'Klasse'. In vielen europäischen Sprachen sehr ähnlich!

explanation.fr: 'Desk' signifie 'bureau' (le meuble). Pour le lieu de travail, on dit 'office'.
explanation.en: 'Desk' is the furniture you work at. 'Office' is the room where you work.
explanation.es: 'Desk' significa 'escritorio' (el mueble). La oficina se dice 'office'.
explanation.de: 'Desk' bedeutet 'Schreibtisch'. Das Büro (Raum) heißt 'office'.

explanation.fr: 'Rain' signifie 'pluie'. Ne pas confondre avec 'reign' (règne) qui se prononce pareil.
explanation.en: 'Rain' is water falling from clouds. 'Rain', 'reign', and 'rein' all sound the same!
explanation.es: 'Rain' significa 'lluvia'. 'Rain', 'reign' y 'rein' se pronuncian igual.
explanation.de: 'Rain' bedeutet 'Regen'. 'Rain', 'reign' und 'rein' klingen gleich!

explanation.fr: 'Snow' signifie 'neige'. Un 'snowman' est un bonhomme de neige.
explanation.en: 'Snow' is frozen water crystals. A 'snowman' is made of packed snow.
explanation.es: 'Snow' significa 'nieve'. Un 'snowman' es un muñeco de nieve.
explanation.de: 'Snow' bedeutet 'Schnee'. Ein 'snowman' ist ein Schneemann.

explanation.fr: 'Hot' signifie 'chaud'. Son contraire est 'cold' (froid).
explanation.en: 'Hot' means high temperature. The opposite is 'cold'.
explanation.es: 'Hot' significa 'caliente'. Su opuesto es 'cold' (frío).
explanation.de: 'Hot' bedeutet 'heiß'. Das Gegenteil ist 'cold' (kalt).

explanation.fr: 'Cold' signifie 'froid'. 'A cold' (nom) signifie aussi un rhume.
explanation.en: 'Cold' means low temperature. As a noun, 'a cold' is a common illness.
explanation.es: 'Cold' significa 'frío'. Como sustantivo, 'a cold' es un resfriado.
explanation.de: 'Cold' bedeutet 'kalt'. Als Substantiv bedeutet 'a cold' eine Erkältung.

explanation.fr: 'Tree' signifie 'arbre'. Ne pas confondre avec 'three' (trois) qui se prononce presque pareil.
explanation.en: 'Tree' is a tall plant with a trunk. Don't confuse it with 'three' (3)!
explanation.es: 'Tree' significa 'árbol'. No confundir con 'three' (tres), que suena casi igual.
explanation.de: 'Tree' bedeutet 'Baum'. Nicht verwechseln mit 'three' (drei)!

explanation.fr: 'Flower' signifie 'fleur'. Ne pas confondre avec 'flour' (farine) qui se prononce pareil !
explanation.en: 'Flower' is a blooming plant. 'Flour' (for baking) sounds exactly the same!
explanation.es: 'Flower' significa 'flor'. 'Flour' (harina) se pronuncia igual.
explanation.de: 'Flower' bedeutet 'Blume'. 'Flour' (Mehl) klingt genauso!

explanation.fr: 'Wind' signifie 'vent'. Identique en allemand ! Mais 'to wind' (verbe) signifie 'enrouler'.
explanation.en: 'Wind' means moving air. Same word in German! As a verb, 'to wind' means to twist.
explanation.es: 'Wind' significa 'viento'. ¡Igual en alemán! Como verbo, significa 'enrollar'.
explanation.de: 'Wind' bedeutet 'Wind'. Identisch im Englischen und Deutschen!

explanation.fr: 'Monday' signifie 'lundi'. Ce mot vient de 'Moon day' (jour de la Lune).
explanation.en: 'Monday' comes from 'Moon day'. In German, 'Montag' also means 'Moon day'.
explanation.es: 'Monday' significa 'lunes'. Viene de 'Moon day' (día de la Luna).
explanation.de: 'Monday' bedeutet 'Montag'. Beide kommen von 'Mond' (Moon)!

explanation.fr: 'Today' signifie 'aujourd'hui'. 'Yesterday' = hier, 'tomorrow' = demain.
explanation.en: 'Today' means this current day. Yesterday is the past, tomorrow is the future.
explanation.es: 'Today' significa 'hoy'. 'Yesterday' = ayer, 'tomorrow' = mañana.
explanation.de: 'Today' bedeutet 'Heute'. 'Yesterday' = gestern, 'tomorrow' = morgen.

explanation.fr: 'Morning' signifie 'matin'. 'Good morning!' = Bonjour ! (le matin uniquement).
explanation.en: 'Morning' is the first part of the day. 'Good morning!' is a common greeting.
explanation.es: 'Morning' significa 'mañana' (la parte del día). 'Good morning!' = ¡Buenos días!
explanation.de: 'Morning' bedeutet 'Morgen'. 'Good morning!' = Guten Morgen!

explanation.fr: 'Night' signifie 'nuit'. Proche de l'allemand 'Nacht'. 'Good night!' = Bonne nuit !
explanation.en: 'Night' is the dark part of the day. Similar to German 'Nacht'.
explanation.es: 'Night' significa 'noche'. Parecido al alemán 'Nacht'.
explanation.de: 'Night' bedeutet 'Nacht'. Die Wörter sind fast identisch!

explanation.fr: 'Clock' signifie 'horloge'. Une montre (au poignet) se dit 'watch', pas 'clock'.
explanation.en: 'Clock' is a time device on a wall. A wrist device is a 'watch'.
explanation.es: 'Clock' significa 'reloj de pared'. El de muñeca se dice 'watch'.
explanation.de: 'Clock' bedeutet 'Uhr' (Wanduhr). Eine Armbanduhr heißt 'watch'.

explanation.fr: 'Year' signifie 'année'. Proche de l'allemand 'Jahr'. 'Happy New Year!' = Bonne année !
explanation.en: 'Year' is 12 months. 'Happy New Year!' is said on January 1st.
explanation.es: 'Year' significa 'año'. 'Happy New Year!' = ¡Feliz Año Nuevo!
explanation.de: 'Year' bedeutet 'Jahr'. Die Wörter sind verwandt!

explanation.fr: 'Week' signifie 'semaine' (7 jours). Le 'weekend' = fin de semaine (samedi et dimanche).
explanation.en: 'Week' is 7 days. The 'weekend' is Saturday and Sunday.
explanation.es: 'Week' significa 'semana'. El 'weekend' es el fin de semana.
explanation.de: 'Week' bedeutet 'Woche'. Das 'weekend' ist das Wochenende.

explanation.fr: 'Eat' signifie 'manger'. Passé irrégulier : eat → ate → eaten.
explanation.en: 'Eat' has irregular past forms: eat → ate → eaten.
explanation.es: 'Eat' significa 'comer'. Pasado irregular: eat → ate → eaten.
explanation.de: 'Eat' bedeutet 'Essen'. Unregelmäßig: eat → ate → eaten.

explanation.fr: 'Sleep' signifie 'dormir'. Passé irrégulier : sleep → slept → slept.
explanation.en: 'Sleep' has irregular past forms: sleep → slept → slept.
explanation.es: 'Sleep' significa 'dormir'. Pasado irregular: sleep → slept → slept.
explanation.de: 'Sleep' bedeutet 'Schlafen'. Unregelmäßig: sleep → slept → slept.

explanation.fr: 'Walk' signifie 'marcher'. Attention : le 'l' est muet, on prononce 'wok'.
explanation.en: 'Walk' means to move on foot. The 'l' is silent — it's pronounced 'wok'.
explanation.es: 'Walk' significa 'caminar'. La 'l' es muda: se pronuncia 'wok'.
explanation.de: 'Walk' bedeutet 'Gehen'. Das 'l' ist stumm — man sagt 'wok'.

explanation.fr: 'Play' signifie 'jouer'. Ce mot signifie aussi 'une pièce de théâtre'.
explanation.en: 'Play' means to have fun or a theater performance. Two meanings!
explanation.es: 'Play' significa 'jugar'. También significa 'obra de teatro'.
explanation.de: 'Play' bedeutet 'Spielen'. Es bedeutet auch 'Theaterstück'.

explanation.fr: 'See' signifie 'voir'. Ne pas confondre avec 'sea' (mer) qui se prononce pareil.
explanation.en: 'See' means to perceive with eyes. 'Sea' (ocean) sounds exactly the same!
explanation.es: 'See' significa 'ver'. 'Sea' (mar) se pronuncia igual.
explanation.de: 'See' bedeutet 'Sehen'. Im Deutschen bedeutet 'See' lac ou mer!

explanation.fr: 'Open' signifie 'ouvrir' ou 'ouvert'. Son contraire est 'close' (fermer) ou 'closed' (fermé).
explanation.en: 'Open' is the opposite of 'closed'. It works as a verb and adjective.
explanation.es: 'Open' significa 'abrir/abierto'. Su opuesto es 'close/closed'.
explanation.de: 'Open' bedeutet 'öffnen/offen'. Das Gegenteil ist 'close/closed'.

explanation.fr: 'Close' signifie 'fermer'. Attention : 'close' peut aussi signifier 'proche' (adjectif).
explanation.en: 'Close' as a verb means to shut. As an adjective, it means 'near'.
explanation.es: 'Close' significa 'cerrar'. También puede significar 'cercano' (adjetivo).
explanation.de: 'Close' bedeutet 'schließen'. Als Adjektiv bedeutet es 'nah'.

explanation.fr: 'Big' signifie 'grand' (taille). Synonyme : 'large'. Contraire : 'small'.
explanation.en: 'Big' means large in size. Synonyms: 'large', 'huge'. Opposite: 'small'.
explanation.es: 'Big' significa 'grande'. Sinónimo: 'large'. Opuesto: 'small'.
explanation.de: 'Big' bedeutet 'groß'. Synonym: 'large'. Gegenteil: 'small'.

explanation.fr: 'Small' signifie 'petit'. Synonyme : 'little'. Contraire : 'big'.
explanation.en: 'Small' means little in size. Synonyms: 'little', 'tiny'. Opposite: 'big'.
explanation.es: 'Small' significa 'pequeño'. Sinónimo: 'little'. Opuesto: 'big'.
explanation.de: 'Small' bedeutet 'klein'. Synonym: 'little'. Gegenteil: 'big'.

explanation.fr: 'Happy' signifie 'heureux'. 'Happy birthday!' = Joyeux anniversaire !
explanation.en: 'Happy' means feeling joy. 'Happy birthday!' is the most common use.
explanation.es: 'Happy' significa 'feliz'. '¡Happy birthday!' = ¡Feliz cumpleaños!
explanation.de: 'Happy' bedeutet 'glücklich'. 'Happy birthday!' = Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!

explanation.fr: 'Sad' signifie 'triste'. Son contraire est 'happy' (heureux).
explanation.en: 'Sad' means unhappy. The opposite is 'happy'.
explanation.es: 'Sad' significa 'triste'. Su opuesto es 'happy' (feliz).
explanation.de: 'Sad' bedeutet 'traurig'. Das Gegenteil ist 'happy' (glücklich).

explanation.fr: 'Good' signifie 'bon'. Attention : 'good' est l'adjectif, 'well' est l'adverbe.
explanation.en: 'Good' is the adjective, 'well' is the adverb. 'I'm good' vs 'I play well'.
explanation.es: 'Good' significa 'bueno'. 'Good' es adjetivo, 'well' es adverbio.
explanation.de: 'Good' bedeutet 'gut' (Adjektiv). 'Well' ist das Adverb.

explanation.fr: 'Bad' signifie 'mauvais'. Attention en allemand : 'Bad' signifie 'bain' — faux ami !
explanation.en: 'Bad' means not good. In German, 'Bad' means 'bath' — a false friend!
explanation.es: 'Bad' significa 'malo'. En alemán, 'Bad' significa 'baño' — ¡falso amigo!
explanation.de: 'Bad' bedeutet 'schlecht'. Achtung: Im Deutschen bedeutet 'Bad' etwas anderes!

explanation.fr: 'New' signifie 'nouveau'. Proche de l'allemand 'Neu'. Contraire : 'old'.
explanation.en: 'New' means recently made. Similar to German 'Neu'. Opposite: 'old'.
explanation.es: 'New' significa 'nuevo'. Parecido al alemán 'Neu'. Opuesto: 'old'.
explanation.de: 'New' bedeutet 'Neu'. Die Wörter sind fast identisch!

explanation.fr: 'Old' signifie 'vieux' ou 'ancien'. Contraire : 'new' (nouveau) ou 'young' (jeune).
explanation.en: 'Old' means not new or not young. Opposites: 'new' (things) or 'young' (people).
explanation.es: 'Old' significa 'viejo'. Opuestos: 'new' (cosas) o 'young' (personas).
explanation.de: 'Old' bedeutet 'alt'. Gegenteile: 'new' (Dinge) oder 'young' (Personen).

explanation.fr: 'Breakfast' signifie 'petit-déjeuner'. Littéralement : 'break' (casser) + 'fast' (jeûne) = rompre le jeûne de la nuit.
explanation.en: 'Breakfast' literally means 'break the fast' — the overnight fast.
explanation.es: 'Breakfast' significa 'desayuno'. Literalmente: 'break' (romper) + 'fast' (ayuno).
explanation.de: 'Breakfast' bedeutet 'Frühstück'. Wörtlich: 'break' (brechen) + 'fast' (Fasten).

explanation.fr: 'To wake up' signifie 'se réveiller'. Contraire : 'to fall asleep' (s'endormir).
explanation.en: 'To wake up' means to stop sleeping. Opposite: 'to fall asleep'.
explanation.es: 'To wake up' significa 'despertarse'. Opuesto: 'to fall asleep'.
explanation.de: 'To wake up' bedeutet 'aufwachen'. Gegenteil: 'to fall asleep'.

question.en: What does 'To brush your teeth' mean?

explanation.fr: 'To brush your teeth' = se brosser les dents. 'Brush' est aussi un nom : une brosse.
explanation.en: 'Brush' is both a verb (to clean) and a noun (the tool). 'Toothbrush' is the tool.
explanation.es: 'To brush your teeth' = cepillarse los dientes. 'Toothbrush' = cepillo de dientes.
explanation.de: 'To brush your teeth' = Zähne putzen. 'Toothbrush' = Zahnbürste.

explanation.fr: 'Lunch' signifie 'déjeuner' (repas du midi). 'Lunch break' = pause déjeuner.
explanation.en: 'Lunch' is the midday meal, usually between 12 and 2 PM.
explanation.es: 'Lunch' significa 'almuerzo'. 'Lunch break' = pausa para comer.
explanation.de: 'Lunch' bedeutet 'Mittagessen'. 'Lunch break' = Mittagspause.

explanation.fr: 'Dinner' signifie 'dîner' (repas du soir). C'est le repas principal de la journée dans les pays anglophones.
explanation.en: 'Dinner' is the main evening meal. In some regions, 'supper' means the same thing.
explanation.es: 'Dinner' significa 'cena'. Es la comida principal de la noche.
explanation.de: 'Dinner' bedeutet 'Abendessen'. Es ist die Hauptmahlzeit am Abend.

question.en: What does 'To take a shower' mean?

explanation.fr: 'Shower' = douche, 'bath' = bain. Les Britanniques disent 'have a shower', les Américains 'take a shower'.
explanation.en: British: 'have a shower'. American: 'take a shower'. Both are correct!
explanation.es: 'Shower' = ducha, 'bath' = baño. Los británicos dicen 'have a shower'.
explanation.de: 'Shower' = Dusche, 'bath' = Bad. Briten sagen 'have a shower'.

explanation.fr: 'To get dressed' = s'habiller. Contraire : 'to get undressed' (se déshabiller).
explanation.en: 'To get dressed' means to put on clothes. Opposite: 'to get undressed'.
explanation.es: 'To get dressed' = vestirse. Opuesto: 'to get undressed' (desvestirse).
explanation.de: 'To get dressed' = sich anziehen. Gegenteil: 'to get undressed'.

explanation.fr: 'Schedule' signifie 'emploi du temps'. Prononciation : 'skédjoule' (US) ou 'chédjoule' (UK).
explanation.en: 'Schedule' is pronounced 'skedjool' (US) or 'shedjool' (UK).
explanation.es: 'Schedule' significa 'horario'. Se pronuncia 'skédyul' (US) o 'shédyul' (UK).
explanation.de: 'Schedule' bedeutet 'Zeitplan'. US: 'skedjuhl', UK: 'shedjuhl'.

explanation.fr: 'Price' = prix (coût). Ne pas confondre avec 'prize' = prix (récompense). Prononciation similaire !
explanation.en: 'Price' is the cost. 'Prize' is a reward. They sound similar but mean different things.
explanation.es: 'Price' = precio. No confundir con 'prize' = premio. ¡Suenan parecido!
explanation.de: 'Price' = Preis (Kosten). 'Prize' = Preis (Auszeichnung). Im Deutschen ist es dasselbe Wort!

explanation.fr: 'Cheap' signifie 'bon marché/pas cher'. Peut aussi signifier 'de mauvaise qualité'.
explanation.en: 'Cheap' means low price but can also imply low quality.
explanation.es: 'Cheap' significa 'barato'. También puede implicar mala calidad.
explanation.de: 'Cheap' bedeutet 'billig'. Kann auch 'minderwertig' bedeuten.

explanation.fr: 'Expensive' signifie 'cher' (coûteux). Attention : 'dear' peut aussi signifier cher (prix) en anglais britannique.
explanation.en: 'Expensive' means costing a lot. In British English, 'dear' can also mean expensive.
explanation.es: 'Expensive' significa 'caro'. En inglés británico, 'dear' también puede significar caro.
explanation.de: 'Expensive' bedeutet 'teuer'. Im Britischen kann 'dear' auch teuer bedeuten.

explanation.fr: 'To pay' signifie 'payer'. Passé irrégulier : pay → paid → paid.
explanation.en: 'To pay' has irregular past: pay → paid → paid. Not 'payed'!
explanation.es: 'To pay' significa 'pagar'. Pasado irregular: pay → paid → paid.
explanation.de: 'To pay' bedeutet 'bezahlen'. Unregelmäßig: pay → paid → paid.

explanation.fr: 'Receipt' = reçu (ticket). Faux ami : 'recipe' = recette de cuisine ! Le 'p' de receipt est muet.
explanation.en: 'Receipt' is proof of payment. Don't confuse with 'recipe' (cooking instructions). The 'p' is silent!
explanation.es: 'Receipt' = recibo. ¡Falso amigo! 'Recipe' = receta de cocina. La 'p' es muda.
explanation.de: 'Receipt' = Quittung. Nicht verwechseln mit 'recipe' (Rezept). Das 'p' ist stumm!

explanation.fr: 'Shop' signifie 'magasin'. Synonyme américain : 'store'. 'To go shopping' = faire du shopping.
explanation.en: 'Shop' (British) and 'store' (American) mean the same thing.
explanation.es: 'Shop' significa 'tienda'. En americano se dice 'store'.
explanation.de: 'Shop' bedeutet 'Geschäft'. In Amerika sagt man 'store'.

explanation.fr: 'To try on' = essayer un vêtement. La cabine d'essayage se dit 'fitting room'.
explanation.en: 'To try on' means to test clothes. The fitting room is where you try on clothes.
explanation.es: 'To try on' = probarse ropa. El probador se dice 'fitting room'.
explanation.de: 'To try on' = anprobieren. Die Umkleidekabine heißt 'fitting room'.

explanation.fr: 'Discount' signifie 'réduction' ou 'remise'. 'On sale' = en promotion.
explanation.en: 'Discount' means a price reduction. 'On sale' means at a discounted price.
explanation.es: 'Discount' significa 'descuento'. 'On sale' = en oferta.
explanation.de: 'Discount' bedeutet 'Rabatt'. 'On sale' = im Angebot.

explanation.fr: 'Airport' signifie 'aéroport'. C'est 'air' (air) + 'port' (port) = le port de l'air.
explanation.en: 'Airport' is 'air' + 'port'. A port for aircraft!
explanation.es: 'Airport' significa 'aeropuerto'. Es 'air' (aire) + 'port' (puerto).
explanation.de: 'Airport' bedeutet 'Flughafen'. Es ist 'air' (Luft) + 'port' (Hafen).

explanation.fr: 'Ticket' signifie 'billet' (transport, spectacle). Aussi utilisé pour une contravention.
explanation.en: 'Ticket' means a pass for transport or events. It can also mean a fine (parking ticket).
explanation.es: 'Ticket' significa 'billete'. También puede ser una multa (parking ticket).
explanation.de: 'Ticket' bedeutet 'Fahrkarte'. Kann auch einen Strafzettel meinen.

explanation.fr: 'Luggage' signifie 'bagages'. Attention : c'est un mot indénombrable, on ne dit pas 'luggages'.
explanation.en: 'Luggage' is uncountable — never say 'luggages'. Use 'a piece of luggage' instead.
explanation.es: 'Luggage' significa 'equipaje'. Es incontable: no se dice 'luggages'.
explanation.de: 'Luggage' bedeutet 'Gepäck'. Es ist unzählbar: nie 'luggages'!

explanation.fr: 'Hotel' signifie 'hôtel'. Attention au faux ami : 'hospital' = hôpital, pas hôtel !
explanation.en: 'Hotel' is for staying overnight. Don't confuse with 'hospital' (for sick people)!
explanation.es: 'Hotel' significa 'hotel'. No confundir con 'hospital' (para enfermos).
explanation.de: 'Hotel' bedeutet 'Hotel'. Nicht verwechseln mit 'hospital' (Krankenhaus)!

explanation.fr: 'Map' signifie 'carte' (géographique). Ne pas confondre avec 'card' (carte de jeu/visite).
explanation.en: 'Map' shows geography. 'Card' is for playing or business cards. Different meanings!
explanation.es: 'Map' significa 'mapa'. 'Card' = carta/tarjeta. ¡Significados diferentes!
explanation.de: 'Map' bedeutet 'Landkarte'. 'Card' = Spielkarte/Visitenkarte.

explanation.fr: 'To arrive' signifie 'arriver'. On dit 'arrive at' (un lieu précis) ou 'arrive in' (une ville/pays).
explanation.en: 'Arrive at' for specific places, 'arrive in' for cities/countries. Never 'arrive to'!
explanation.es: 'To arrive' = llegar. 'Arrive at' (lugar) o 'arrive in' (ciudad). ¡Nunca 'arrive to'!
explanation.de: 'To arrive' = ankommen. 'Arrive at' (Ort) oder 'arrive in' (Stadt). Nie 'arrive to'!

explanation.fr: 'Passport' signifie 'passeport'. Vient de 'pass' (passer) + 'port' (porte/port). Passer la porte !
explanation.en: 'Passport' comes from 'pass' + 'port'. Literally: to pass through a port/gate.
explanation.es: 'Passport' significa 'pasaporte'. Viene de 'pass' (pasar) + 'port' (puerta).
explanation.de: 'Passport' bedeutet 'Reisepass'. Von 'pass' (passieren) + 'port' (Tor).

explanation.fr: 'Station' signifie 'gare' ou 'station'. 'Train station' = gare, 'bus station' = gare routière.
explanation.en: 'Station' can be a train station, bus station, or even a radio/TV station.
explanation.es: 'Station' = estación. 'Train station', 'bus station', 'radio station'...
explanation.de: 'Station' = Bahnhof/Station. 'Train station', 'bus station', 'radio station'...

explanation.fr: 'Excited' = enthousiaste, impatient. Faux ami ! En français 'excité' a souvent une connotation différente.
explanation.en: 'Excited' means eager and enthusiastic. In French, 'excité' can have different connotations!
explanation.es: 'Excited' = emocionado. ¡Cuidado! En francés, 'excité' tiene connotaciones diferentes.
explanation.de: 'Excited' = aufgeregt (positiv). Im Französischen hat 'excité' andere Konnotationen!

explanation.fr: 'Worried' signifie 'inquiet'. 'Don't worry!' = Ne t'inquiète pas !
explanation.en: 'Worried' means anxious. 'Don't worry!' is a common reassurance.
explanation.es: 'Worried' significa 'preocupado'. '¡Don't worry!' = ¡No te preocupes!
explanation.de: 'Worried' bedeutet 'besorgt'. 'Don't worry!' = Mach dir keine Sorgen!

explanation.fr: 'Tired' signifie 'fatigué'. 'Tired of' = en avoir marre de. Ex: 'I'm tired of waiting'.
explanation.en: 'Tired' means needing rest. 'Tired of' means fed up with something.
explanation.es: 'Tired' = cansado. 'Tired of' = harto de algo. Ej: 'I'm tired of waiting'.
explanation.de: 'Tired' = müde. 'Tired of' = etwas leid sein. Z.B.: 'I'm tired of waiting'.

explanation.fr: 'Bored' = ennuyé. Attention : 'boring' = ennuyeux. 'I am bored' ≠ 'I am boring' !
explanation.en: 'Bored' = feeling bored. 'Boring' = causing boredom. Big difference!
explanation.es: 'Bored' = aburrido (yo). 'Boring' = aburrido (algo). ¡Gran diferencia!
explanation.de: 'Bored' = gelangweilt. 'Boring' = langweilig. Großer Unterschied!

explanation.fr: 'Surprised' signifie 'surpris'. 'Surprise party' = fête surprise.
explanation.en: 'Surprised' means caught off guard. A 'surprise party' is an unexpected celebration.
explanation.es: 'Surprised' = sorprendido. 'Surprise party' = fiesta sorpresa.
explanation.de: 'Surprised' = überrascht. 'Surprise party' = Überraschungsparty.

explanation.fr: 'Proud' signifie 'fier'. 'I'm proud of you' = Je suis fier de toi.
explanation.en: 'Proud' means feeling satisfaction. 'I'm proud of you' is a common compliment.
explanation.es: 'Proud' = orgulloso. 'I'm proud of you' = Estoy orgulloso de ti.
explanation.de: 'Proud' = stolz. 'I'm proud of you' = Ich bin stolz auf dich.

explanation.fr: 'Nervous' = nerveux/anxieux. Faux ami ! 'Énervé' en français se traduit par 'annoyed' ou 'irritated'.
explanation.en: 'Nervous' means anxious, not angry. French 'énervé' translates to 'annoyed'.
explanation.es: 'Nervous' = nervioso/ansioso. El francés 'énervé' se traduce como 'annoyed'.
explanation.de: 'Nervous' = nervös/ängstlich. Nicht verwechseln mit dem französischen 'énervé' (genervt).

explanation.fr: 'Disappointed' signifie 'déçu'. 'I'm disappointed in you' = Je suis déçu de toi.
explanation.en: 'Disappointed' means let down. 'Disappointing' describes the cause of disappointment.
explanation.es: 'Disappointed' = decepcionado. 'Disappointing' describe la causa de la decepción.
explanation.de: 'Disappointed' = enttäuscht. 'Disappointing' beschreibt die Ursache.

explanation.fr: 'Doctor' signifie 'médecin'. Abréviation : Dr. On dit aussi 'GP' (General Practitioner) au Royaume-Uni.
explanation.en: 'Doctor' is abbreviated 'Dr.' In the UK, a GP is a General Practitioner.
explanation.es: 'Doctor' = médico. En el Reino Unido, un GP es un médico de cabecera.
explanation.de: 'Doctor' = Arzt. In Großbritannien heißt der Hausarzt 'GP' (General Practitioner).

explanation.fr: 'Nurse' signifie 'infirmier(ère)'. Ce mot vient du latin 'nutrire' (nourrir, soigner).
explanation.en: 'Nurse' comes from Latin 'nutrire' (to nourish). Also means a children's caretaker.
explanation.es: 'Nurse' = enfermero/a. Viene del latín 'nutrire' (nutrir, cuidar).
explanation.de: 'Nurse' = Krankenschwester. Kommt vom Lateinischen 'nutrire' (nähren, pflegen).

explanation.fr: 'Firefighter' signifie 'pompier'. Littéralement : 'fire' (feu) + 'fighter' (combattant) = combattant du feu.
explanation.en: 'Firefighter' is 'fire' + 'fighter'. The old term 'fireman' is now less used.
explanation.es: 'Firefighter' = bombero. Literalmente: 'fire' (fuego) + 'fighter' (luchador).
explanation.de: 'Firefighter' = Feuerwehrmann. 'Fire' (Feuer) + 'fighter' (Kämpfer).

explanation.fr: 'Lawyer' signifie 'avocat' (le métier). L'avocat (fruit) se dit 'avocado' en anglais !
explanation.en: 'Lawyer' is a legal professional. The fruit 'avocado' sounds like 'avocat' in French!
explanation.es: 'Lawyer' = abogado. ¡El fruto 'avocado' suena como 'avocat' en francés!
explanation.de: 'Lawyer' = Anwalt. Die Frucht 'avocado' klingt wie 'avocat' auf Französisch!

explanation.fr: 'Engineer' signifie 'ingénieur'. Ce mot est similaire en français, espagnol et allemand.
explanation.en: 'Engineer' designs and builds things. Similar in many European languages.
explanation.es: 'Engineer' = ingeniero. Similar en francés, español y alemán.
explanation.de: 'Engineer' = Ingenieur. In vielen europäischen Sprachen sehr ähnlich.

explanation.fr: 'Chef' en anglais = cuisinier professionnel. Faux ami ! Le 'chef' français (patron) se dit 'boss' en anglais.
explanation.en: 'Chef' means a professional cook. In French, 'chef' means boss — a false friend!
explanation.es: 'Chef' en inglés = cocinero profesional. En francés, 'chef' = jefe. ¡Falso amigo!
explanation.de: 'Chef' auf Englisch = Profikoch. Im Französischen bedeutet 'chef' = Vorgesetzter!

explanation.fr: 'Pilot' signifie 'pilote'. Ce mot est presque identique dans les 4 langues !
explanation.en: 'Pilot' flies the aircraft. Almost the same word in French, Spanish, and German!
explanation.es: 'Pilot' = piloto. ¡Casi idéntico en francés, español y alemán!
explanation.de: 'Pilot' = Pilot. Fast identisch in allen vier Sprachen!

explanation.fr: 'Dentist' signifie 'dentiste'. Du latin 'dens' = dent, qu'on retrouve dans 'dental'.
explanation.en: 'Dentist' comes from Latin 'dens' (tooth). Related to 'dental'.
explanation.es: 'Dentist' = dentista. Del latín 'dens' = diente.
explanation.de: 'Dentist' = Zahnarzt. Vom Lateinischen 'dens' = Zahn.

explanation.fr: 'Headache' = mal de tête. C'est 'head' (tête) + 'ache' (douleur). Le suffixe '-ache' = douleur.
explanation.en: 'Headache' is 'head' + 'ache'. The suffix '-ache' means pain: stomachache, toothache, backache.
explanation.es: 'Headache' = dolor de cabeza. 'Head' + 'ache' (dolor). Sufijo '-ache' = dolor.
explanation.de: 'Headache' = Kopfschmerzen. 'Head' + 'ache' (Schmerz). '-ache' = Schmerz.

explanation.fr: 'Medicine' signifie 'médicament' ou 'médecine' (la discipline).
explanation.en: 'Medicine' means both medication (pills) and the medical profession.
explanation.es: 'Medicine' = medicamento o medicina (la disciplina).
explanation.de: 'Medicine' = Medikament oder Medizin (das Fach).

explanation.fr: 'To cough' signifie 'tousser'. Se prononce 'koff'. Le 'gh' se prononce 'f' ici !
explanation.en: 'Cough' is pronounced 'koff'. The 'gh' makes an 'f' sound — unusual in English!
explanation.es: 'To cough' = toser. Se pronuncia 'kof'. ¡El 'gh' suena como 'f'!
explanation.de: 'To cough' = husten. Aussprache: 'kof'. Das 'gh' klingt wie 'f'!

explanation.fr: 'Fever' signifie 'fièvre'. Proche du français et très similaire en espagnol et allemand.
explanation.en: 'Fever' means high body temperature. Similar in French, Spanish, and German.
explanation.es: 'Fever' = fiebre. Muy similar en francés ('fièvre') y alemán ('Fieber').
explanation.de: 'Fever' = Fieber. Sehr ähnlich in allen vier Sprachen!

explanation.fr: 'Hospital' signifie 'hôpital'. Les deux mots viennent du latin 'hospitale' (lieu d'accueil).
explanation.en: 'Hospital' and 'hotel' both come from Latin 'hospitale' (a place for guests).
explanation.es: 'Hospital' = hospital. Ambos vienen del latín 'hospitale' (lugar de acogida).
explanation.de: 'Hospital' = Krankenhaus. 'Hospital' und 'Hotel' kommen vom Lateinischen 'hospitale'.

explanation.fr: 'Appointment' = rendez-vous (médical, professionnel). Pour un rendez-vous amoureux, on dit 'date'.
explanation.en: 'Appointment' is a scheduled meeting (doctor, business). A romantic meeting is a 'date'.
explanation.es: 'Appointment' = cita (médica, profesional). Una cita romántica es 'date'.
explanation.de: 'Appointment' = Termin (Arzt, Geschäft). Ein romantisches Treffen ist ein 'date'.

explanation.fr: 'Allergy' signifie 'allergie'. Presque identique dans les 4 langues ! L'adjectif est 'allergic'.
explanation.en: 'Allergy' is nearly the same in all four languages! The adjective is 'allergic'.
explanation.es: 'Allergy' = alergia. ¡Casi idéntico en los 4 idiomas! El adjetivo es 'allergic'.
explanation.de: 'Allergy' = Allergie. Fast identisch in allen 4 Sprachen! Adjektiv: 'allergic'.

explanation.fr: 'Bandage' signifie 'bandage' ou 'pansement'. Identique en français !
explanation.en: 'Bandage' is a strip of material for wrapping wounds. Same word in French!
explanation.es: 'Bandage' = vendaje/venda. ¡Es la misma palabra en francés!
explanation.de: 'Bandage' = Verband. Im Französischen ist es dasselbe Wort!

question.fr: Quelle forme est correcte ? 'She ___ a book right now.'
question.en: Which is correct? 'She ___ a book right now.'
question.es: ¿Cuál es correcta? 'She ___ a book right now.'
question.de: Was ist richtig? 'She ___ a book right now.'

explanation.fr: 'Right now' indique une action en cours → présent continu (is + -ing). 'Reads' = habitude.
explanation.en: 'Right now' signals an ongoing action → present continuous (is + -ing). 'Reads' = habit.
explanation.es: 'Right now' indica acción en curso → presente continuo (is + -ing). 'Reads' = hábito.
explanation.de: 'Right now' zeigt eine laufende Handlung → Present Continuous (is + -ing). 'Reads' = Gewohnheit.

question.fr: Quelle forme est correcte ? 'Yesterday I ___ to the supermarket.'
question.en: Which is correct? 'Yesterday I ___ to the supermarket.'
question.es: ¿Cuál es correcta? 'Yesterday I ___ to the supermarket.'
question.de: Was ist richtig? 'Yesterday I ___ to the supermarket.'

explanation.fr: 'Yesterday' → passé simple. 'Go' est irrégulier : go → went → gone.
explanation.en: 'Yesterday' requires past tense. 'Go' is irregular: go → went → gone.
explanation.es: 'Yesterday' → pasado. 'Go' es irregular: go → went → gone.
explanation.de: 'Yesterday' → Vergangenheit. 'Go' ist unregelmäßig: go → went → gone.

explanation.fr: 'Swimming' signifie 'natation'. 'Swimming pool' = piscine.
explanation.en: 'Swimming' is a water sport. A 'swimming pool' is where you swim.
explanation.es: 'Swimming' = natación. 'Swimming pool' = piscina.
explanation.de: 'Swimming' = Schwimmen. 'Swimming pool' = Schwimmbad.

explanation.fr: 'To draw' signifie 'dessiner'. Aussi : 'a draw' = un match nul (sport). Passé : drew → drawn.
explanation.en: 'To draw' means to sketch. It also means a tie in sports. Past: drew → drawn.
explanation.es: 'To draw' = dibujar. También: 'a draw' = empate. Pasado: drew → drawn.
explanation.de: 'To draw' = zeichnen. Auch: 'a draw' = Unentschieden. Vergangenheit: drew → drawn.

explanation.fr: 'Guitar' signifie 'guitare'. Mot très similaire dans les 4 langues !
explanation.en: 'Guitar' is a stringed instrument. Nearly the same word in all four languages!
explanation.es: 'Guitar' = guitarra. ¡Muy similar en los 4 idiomas!
explanation.de: 'Guitar' = Gitarre. In allen vier Sprachen sehr ähnlich!

question.en: What does 'Football' mean in British English?

explanation.fr: En anglais britannique, 'football' = soccer. En américain, 'football' = football américain, et ils disent 'soccer'.
explanation.en: In British English, 'football' = soccer. In American English, 'football' = American football.
explanation.es: En británico, 'football' = fútbol. En americano, 'football' = fútbol americano.
explanation.de: Im Britischen: 'football' = Fußball. Im Amerikanischen: 'football' = American Football.

explanation.fr: 'To sing' signifie 'chanter'. Irrégulier : sing → sang → sung. Un chanteur = a 'singer'.
explanation.en: 'To sing' is irregular: sing → sang → sung. A 'singer' is someone who sings.
explanation.es: 'To sing' = cantar. Irregular: sing → sang → sung. Cantante = 'singer'.
explanation.de: 'To sing' = singen. Unregelmäßig: sing → sang → sung. Sänger = 'singer'.

explanation.fr: 'Dancing' signifie 'danse'. Un danseur = a 'dancer'. 'Dance floor' = piste de danse.
explanation.en: 'Dancing' is moving to music. A 'dancer' dances on the 'dance floor'.
explanation.es: 'Dancing' = baile. Bailarín = 'dancer'. 'Dance floor' = pista de baile.
explanation.de: 'Dancing' = Tanzen. Tänzer = 'dancer'. 'Dance floor' = Tanzfläche.

explanation.fr: 'Photography' = photographie. Du grec 'photos' (lumière) + 'graphe' (écriture) = écriture avec la lumière.
explanation.en: 'Photography' comes from Greek: 'photos' (light) + 'graphe' (writing) = writing with light.
explanation.es: 'Photography' = fotografía. Del griego 'photos' (luz) + 'graphe' (escritura).
explanation.de: 'Photography' = Fotografie. Vom Griechischen 'photos' (Licht) + 'graphe' (Schrift).

explanation.fr: 'Cycling' signifie 'cyclisme' (faire du vélo). Un cycliste = a 'cyclist'.
explanation.en: 'Cycling' means riding a bicycle. A 'cyclist' is someone who cycles.
explanation.es: 'Cycling' = ciclismo. Un ciclista = 'cyclist'.
explanation.de: 'Cycling' = Radfahren. Ein Radfahrer = 'cyclist'.

explanation.fr: 'Recipe' = recette de cuisine. Ne pas confondre avec 'receipt' (reçu/ticket de caisse) !
explanation.en: 'Recipe' is cooking instructions. 'Receipt' is proof of payment. Easy to mix up!
explanation.es: 'Recipe' = receta de cocina. No confundir con 'receipt' (recibo).
explanation.de: 'Recipe' = Kochrezept. Nicht verwechseln mit 'receipt' (Quittung)!

explanation.fr: 'To boil' signifie 'faire bouillir'. 'Boiling water' = eau bouillante. 'Boiled egg' = œuf à la coque.
explanation.en: 'To boil' means to heat water to 100°C. 'Boiled egg' is a common breakfast.
explanation.es: 'To boil' = hervir. 'Boiled egg' = huevo cocido.
explanation.de: 'To boil' = kochen/sieden. 'Boiled egg' = gekochtes Ei.

explanation.fr: 'Oven' signifie 'four'. Très proche de l'allemand 'Ofen' !
explanation.en: 'Oven' is for baking and roasting. Very similar to German 'Ofen'!
explanation.es: 'Oven' = horno. ¡Muy parecido al alemán 'Ofen'!
explanation.de: 'Oven' = Ofen. Die Wörter sind fast identisch!

explanation.fr: 'Spicy' signifie 'épicé'. Vient de 'spice' (épice). 'A spice' = une épice.
explanation.en: 'Spicy' comes from 'spice'. Hot peppers make food spicy!
explanation.es: 'Spicy' = picante. Viene de 'spice' (especia).
explanation.de: 'Spicy' = scharf/würzig. Kommt von 'spice' (Gewürz).

explanation.fr: 'Dessert' (2 s) = dessert. 'Desert' (1 s) = désert. Le dessert est tellement bon qu'il mérite un 's' de plus !
explanation.en: 'Dessert' (2 s's) = sweet course. 'Desert' (1 s) = dry land. Dessert has 2 s's because you want seconds!
explanation.es: 'Dessert' (2 s) = postre. 'Desert' (1 s) = desierto. ¡El postre tiene 2 s porque quieres repetir!
explanation.de: 'Dessert' (2 s) = Nachtisch. 'Desert' (1 s) = Wüste. Dessert hat 2 s, weil man mehr will!

explanation.fr: 'To mix' signifie 'mélanger'. Un 'mixer' est l'appareil de cuisine pour mélanger.
explanation.en: 'To mix' means to combine. A 'mixer' is the kitchen appliance.
explanation.es: 'To mix' = mezclar. Un 'mixer' es el electrodoméstico de cocina.
explanation.de: 'To mix' = mischen. Ein 'Mixer' ist das Küchengerät.

explanation.fr: 'Ingredients' signifie 'ingrédients'. Presque identique en français et espagnol !
explanation.en: 'Ingredients' are the foods/items needed for a recipe. Same word in French!
explanation.es: 'Ingredients' = ingredientes. ¡Casi idéntico en francés y español!
explanation.de: 'Ingredients' = Zutaten. Im Französischen und Spanischen fast identisch!

explanation.fr: 'Taste' signifie 'goût'. Faux ami en allemand : 'Taste' = touche (de clavier) !
explanation.en: 'Taste' is both a noun (flavor) and verb (to try food). In German, 'Taste' means keyboard key!
explanation.es: 'Taste' = sabor/gusto. En alemán, 'Taste' = tecla de teclado. ¡Falso amigo!
explanation.de: 'Taste' = Geschmack. Achtung: Im Deutschen bedeutet 'Taste' etwas anderes!

explanation.fr: 'Bus' signifie 'autobus'. C'est l'abréviation de 'omnibus' (du latin 'pour tous').
explanation.en: 'Bus' is short for 'omnibus', from Latin meaning 'for everyone'.
explanation.es: 'Bus' = autobús. Es la abreviatura de 'omnibus' (del latín 'para todos').
explanation.de: 'Bus' = Bus. Es ist die Abkürzung von 'Omnibus' (Latein: 'für alle').

explanation.fr: 'Train' signifie 'train'. 'To train' (verbe) signifie aussi 's'entraîner' — deux sens !
explanation.en: 'Train' is a rail vehicle. As a verb, 'to train' means to practice or exercise.
explanation.es: 'Train' = tren. Como verbo, 'to train' = entrenar.
explanation.de: 'Train' = Zug. Als Verb bedeutet 'to train' = trainieren.

explanation.fr: 'Bicycle' signifie 'vélo'. Du préfixe 'bi' (deux) + 'cycle' (roue). On dit aussi 'bike'.
explanation.en: 'Bicycle' is 'bi' (two) + 'cycle' (wheel). Commonly shortened to 'bike'.
explanation.es: 'Bicycle' = bicicleta. 'Bi' (dos) + 'cycle' (rueda). Se acorta a 'bike'.
explanation.de: 'Bicycle' = Fahrrad. 'Bi' (zwei) + 'cycle' (Rad). Kurz: 'bike'.

explanation.fr: 'To drive' signifie 'conduire'. Irrégulier : drive → drove → driven. 'Driver' = conducteur.
explanation.en: 'To drive' is irregular: drive → drove → driven. A 'driver' drives a vehicle.
explanation.es: 'To drive' = conducir. Irregular: drive → drove → driven.
explanation.de: 'To drive' = fahren. Unregelmäßig: drive → drove → driven.

explanation.fr: 'Traffic' signifie 'circulation'. 'Traffic jam' = embouteillage. 'Traffic light' = feu de circulation.
explanation.en: 'Traffic' is vehicles on the road. 'Traffic jam' = congestion. 'Traffic light' = signal.
explanation.es: 'Traffic' = tráfico. 'Traffic jam' = atasco. 'Traffic light' = semáforo.
explanation.de: 'Traffic' = Verkehr. 'Traffic jam' = Stau. 'Traffic light' = Ampel.

explanation.fr: 'Parking' en anglais = le fait de stationner. Le lieu se dit 'parking lot' (US) ou 'car park' (UK).
explanation.en: 'Parking' is the act of stopping a car. The place is a 'parking lot' (US) or 'car park' (UK).
explanation.es: 'Parking' = estacionar. El lugar es 'parking lot' (US) o 'car park' (UK).
explanation.de: 'Parking' = Parken. Der Ort heißt 'parking lot' (US) oder 'car park' (UK).

explanation.fr: 'Highway' signifie 'autoroute'. En UK on dit aussi 'motorway'. 'Highway' = high (principal) + way (chemin).
explanation.en: 'Highway' (US) = 'motorway' (UK). It means a major road for fast travel.
explanation.es: 'Highway' = autopista. En británico se dice 'motorway'.
explanation.de: 'Highway' = Autobahn. Im Britischen sagt man 'motorway'.

explanation.fr: 'Beach' signifie 'plage'. 'Beach volleyball' = volleyball de plage.
explanation.en: 'Beach' is a sandy area by the sea. 'Beach volleyball' is a popular sport.
explanation.es: 'Beach' = playa. 'Beach volleyball' = vóley playa.
explanation.de: 'Beach' = Strand. 'Beach volleyball' = Beachvolleyball.

explanation.fr: 'Mountain' signifie 'montagne'. Vient du français 'montagne' ! 'Mountain bike' = VTT.
explanation.en: 'Mountain' comes from French 'montagne'. A 'mountain bike' is for rough terrain.
explanation.es: 'Mountain' = montaña. Viene del francés 'montagne'. 'Mountain bike' = bicicleta de montaña.
explanation.de: 'Mountain' = Berg. Kommt vom Französischen 'montagne'. 'Mountain bike' = Mountainbike.

explanation.fr: 'River' signifie 'rivière' ou 'fleuve'. Proche du français 'rivière'.
explanation.en: 'River' is a flowing body of water. Similar to French 'rivière'.
explanation.es: 'River' = río. Parecido al francés 'rivière'.
explanation.de: 'River' = Fluss. Ähnlich dem französischen 'rivière'.

explanation.fr: 'Forest' signifie 'forêt'. Presque identique au français ! 'Rainforest' = forêt tropicale.
explanation.en: 'Forest' is a large area of trees. A 'rainforest' is a tropical forest.
explanation.es: 'Forest' = bosque. 'Rainforest' = selva tropical.
explanation.de: 'Forest' = Wald. 'Rainforest' = Regenwald.

explanation.fr: 'Island' signifie 'île'. Attention : le 's' est muet ! On prononce 'aïlande'.
explanation.en: 'Island' is land surrounded by water. The 's' is silent — pronounced 'eye-land'.
explanation.es: 'Island' = isla. ¡La 's' es muda! Se pronuncia 'áiland'.
explanation.de: 'Island' = Insel. Das 's' ist stumm! Aussprache: 'ailänd'.

explanation.fr: 'Lake' signifie 'lac'. Très proche du français ! 'Lake Geneva' = le Lac Léman.
explanation.en: 'Lake' is an inland body of water. 'Lake Geneva' is Lac Léman in French.
explanation.es: 'Lake' = lago. 'Lake Geneva' = Lago Lemán.
explanation.de: 'Lake' = See. 'Lake Geneva' = Genfersee.

explanation.fr: 'Desert' (1 s) = désert. 'Dessert' (2 s) = dessert. Le désert est sec, le dessert est sucré !
explanation.en: 'Desert' (1 s, stress on first syllable) = dry land. 'Dessert' (2 s's, stress on second) = sweet course.
explanation.es: 'Desert' (1 s) = desierto. 'Dessert' (2 s) = postre. ¡El acento cambia!
explanation.de: 'Desert' (1 s) = Wüste. 'Dessert' (2 s) = Nachtisch. Betonung ist verschieden!

explanation.fr: 'Friend' signifie 'ami'. Proche de l'allemand 'Freund'. 'Friendship' = amitié.
explanation.en: 'Friend' is someone you like. Similar to German 'Freund'. 'Friendship' = the bond.
explanation.es: 'Friend' = amigo. Parecido al alemán 'Freund'. 'Friendship' = amistad.
explanation.de: 'Friend' = Freund. Die Wörter sind verwandt! 'Friendship' = Freundschaft.

explanation.fr: 'Neighbour' (UK) / 'Neighbor' (US) signifie 'voisin'. Le 'gh' est muet !
explanation.en: 'Neighbour' (UK) or 'Neighbor' (US). The 'gh' is silent!
explanation.es: 'Neighbour' (UK) / 'Neighbor' (US) = vecino. ¡El 'gh' es mudo!
explanation.de: 'Neighbour' (UK) / 'Neighbor' (US) = Nachbar. Das 'gh' ist stumm!

explanation.fr: 'Colleague' signifie 'collègue'. Presque identique en français et allemand ('Kollege').
explanation.en: 'Colleague' is a work partner. Nearly the same in French and German!
explanation.es: 'Colleague' = colega. ¡Casi idéntico en francés y alemán!
explanation.de: 'Colleague' = Kollege. Fast identisch in allen Sprachen!

explanation.fr: 'To invite' signifie 'inviter'. Une 'invitation' s'écrit pareil en anglais et en français.
explanation.en: 'To invite' means to ask someone to come. 'Invitation' is the same in French!
explanation.es: 'To invite' = invitar. 'Invitation' se escribe igual en francés.
explanation.de: 'To invite' = einladen. 'Invitation' ist im Französischen gleich!

explanation.fr: 'Wedding' = la cérémonie de mariage. 'Marriage' = le mariage en général (état civil).
explanation.en: 'Wedding' is the ceremony. 'Marriage' is the ongoing relationship/legal status.
explanation.es: 'Wedding' = la ceremonia. 'Marriage' = el matrimonio en general.
explanation.de: 'Wedding' = die Zeremonie. 'Marriage' = die Ehe allgemein.

explanation.fr: 'To argue' signifie 'se disputer'. Faux ami ! En français 'argumenter' est plus neutre.
explanation.en: 'To argue' means to disagree verbally. It's stronger than 'to discuss'.
explanation.es: 'To argue' = discutir/pelear. Es más fuerte que 'to discuss'.
explanation.de: 'To argue' = streiten. Es ist stärker als 'to discuss' (diskutieren).

explanation.fr: 'Together' signifie 'ensemble'. Contraire : 'alone' (seul) ou 'apart' (séparés).
explanation.en: 'Together' means with each other. Opposite: 'alone' or 'apart'.
explanation.es: 'Together' = juntos. Opuesto: 'alone' (solo) o 'apart' (separados).
explanation.de: 'Together' = zusammen. Gegenteil: 'alone' (allein) oder 'apart' (getrennt).

explanation.fr: 'To clean' signifie 'nettoyer'. 'Clean' est aussi un adjectif : une chambre propre = 'a clean room'.
explanation.en: 'Clean' works as verb (to clean) and adjective (a clean room).
explanation.es: 'To clean' = limpiar. 'Clean' también es adjetivo: 'a clean room' = un cuarto limpio.
explanation.de: 'To clean' = reinigen. 'Clean' ist auch Adjektiv: 'a clean room' = ein sauberes Zimmer.

explanation.fr: 'Laundry' = lessive ou linge à laver. 'To do the laundry' = faire la lessive.
explanation.en: 'Laundry' is clothes to be washed. 'To do the laundry' = to wash clothes.
explanation.es: 'Laundry' = colada. 'To do the laundry' = hacer la colada.
explanation.de: 'Laundry' = Wäsche. 'To do the laundry' = Wäsche waschen.

explanation.fr: 'Garbage' (US) = 'rubbish' (UK) signifie 'ordures/déchets'.
explanation.en: 'Garbage' (US) = 'rubbish' (UK). Both mean waste or trash.
explanation.es: 'Garbage' (US) = 'rubbish' (UK) = basura.
explanation.de: 'Garbage' (US) = 'rubbish' (UK) = Müll/Abfall.

explanation.fr: 'To fix' signifie 'réparer'. Aussi : 'to fix a date' = fixer une date.
explanation.en: 'To fix' means to repair. Also: 'to fix a date' = to set a date.
explanation.es: 'To fix' = reparar. También: 'to fix a date' = fijar una fecha.
explanation.de: 'To fix' = reparieren. Auch: 'to fix a date' = ein Datum festlegen.

explanation.fr: 'Fridge' signifie 'réfrigérateur'. C'est l'abréviation de 'refrigerator'.
explanation.en: 'Fridge' is short for 'refrigerator'. Note the 'd' in fridge but not in refrigerator!
explanation.es: 'Fridge' = nevera. Es la abreviatura de 'refrigerator'. ¡Nota la 'd'!
explanation.de: 'Fridge' = Kühlschrank. Kurzform von 'refrigerator'. Beachte das 'd'!

explanation.fr: 'Stairs' signifie 'escalier'. 'Upstairs' = en haut, 'downstairs' = en bas.
explanation.en: 'Stairs' are steps. 'Upstairs' = upper floor. 'Downstairs' = lower floor.
explanation.es: 'Stairs' = escaleras. 'Upstairs' = arriba. 'Downstairs' = abajo.
explanation.de: 'Stairs' = Treppe. 'Upstairs' = oben. 'Downstairs' = unten.

explanation.fr: 'Shelf' signifie 'étagère'. Pluriel irrégulier : shelves (comme wolf → wolves).
explanation.en: 'Shelf' has irregular plural: shelves. Like wolf → wolves, knife → knives.
explanation.es: 'Shelf' = estante. Plural irregular: shelves (como wolf → wolves).
explanation.de: 'Shelf' = Regal. Unregelmäßiger Plural: shelves (wie wolf → wolves).

explanation.en: 'Any' for questions and negatives. 'Some' for affirmative sentences.
explanation.es: 'Any' para preguntas y negaciones. 'Some' para afirmaciones.
explanation.de: 'Any' für Fragen und Verneinungen. 'Some' für bejahende Sätze.

explanation.en: 'Many' for countable nouns (books). 'Much' for uncountable nouns (water, money).
explanation.es: 'Many' para contables (books). 'Much' para incontables (water, money).
explanation.de: 'Many' für zählbare Nomen (books). 'Much' für unzählbare (water, money).

explanation.en: Short adjectives (1 syllable): add '-er'. Big → bigger. Long ones use 'more': more beautiful.
explanation.es: Adjetivos cortos (1 sílaba): se añade '-er'. Big → bigger. Largos: 'more beautiful'.
explanation.de: Kurze Adjektive (1 Silbe): + '-er'. Big → bigger. Lange: 'more beautiful'.

explanation.en: 'Good' is irregular: good → better → best. Never 'gooder' or 'goodest'!
explanation.es: 'Good' es irregular: good → better → best. ¡Nunca 'gooder' ni 'goodest'!
explanation.de: 'Good' ist unregelmäßig: good → better → best. Nie 'gooder' oder 'goodest'!

explanation.fr: 'Be going to' + verbe = futur planifié. 'I'm going to visit' = je vais rendre visite (plan).
explanation.en: 'Be going to' expresses a planned future action. 'I'm going to visit' = a firm plan.
explanation.es: 'Be going to' + verbo = futuro planificado. 'I'm going to visit' = voy a visitar.
explanation.de: 'Be going to' + Verb = geplante Zukunft. 'I'm going to visit' = ich werde besuchen.

explanation.fr: 'Must' = obligation forte (la loi). 'Should' = conseil. La ceinture est obligatoire → 'must'.
explanation.en: 'Must' = strong obligation (law). 'Should' = advice. Seatbelts are required by law → 'must'.
explanation.es: 'Must' = obligación fuerte (ley). 'Should' = consejo. El cinturón es obligatorio → 'must'.
explanation.de: 'Must' = starke Pflicht (Gesetz). 'Should' = Rat. Gurtpflicht → 'must'.
